summary: Frontend-only re-verification after design pass. All 8 review-request expectations pass functionally on the public URL. Hero, provenance strip, sticky side-nav (5 items scroll + active-highlight), topology (3 panels with honest NOT_* states), 5-gate ladder (all UNAVAILABLE, no progress bar), mode toggle + LIVE curtain + switch-back, 10 evidence cards + drawer open/close, roadmap 12/3/4, and both copy-repo-anchor buttons render and are clickable. No fabricated LIVE data appears. One minor non-blocking issue: copy-repo-anchor handlers do not catch clipboard write rejection, which surfaces the React dev error overlay in headless/non-secure contexts.

integration_issues.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() promise rejection is uncaught -> 'NotAllowedError: Write permission denied' shows the dev error overlay in headless browsers. App does not crash and state is preserved, but a try/catch (or document.execCommand fallback) is recommended.

verified_expectations: App loads, no runtime/console errors (only the clipboard rejection above, on explicit click)
Hero shows 'PhoneBoost' + 'Use the power already in your pocket' with tag/head/native/toolchain/validated chips
side-nav renders 5 items nav-overview/topology/ladder/evidence/roadmap; clicking each scrolls the matching #section into view and IntersectionObserver updates active styles
Topology renders 3 panels (Computer Linux x86-64 / Secure link / Android phone ARM64) with honest chips NOT_RUNNING_IN_HOSTED_BROWSER, NOT_ESTABLISHED, NOT_CONNECTED
gate-ladder shows 5 gates (paired, authenticated, controller_lease, resource_admissible, provider_ready) all UNAVAILABLE; no progress/progressbar element present
mode-toggle-live reveals live-curtain with 'LIVE mode is unavailable'; mode-badge='Live · unavailable'; switch-to-recorded closes curtain and restores recorded evidence
Evidence grid renders exactly 10 cards; clicking evidence-card-workspace-tests opens evidence-drawer, evidence-drawer-close closes it
Roadmap columns roadmap-working=12, roadmap-next=3, roadmap-future=4 <li> items
copy-repo-anchor and copy-repo-anchor-hero present and clickable
action_items: Wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch (or .catch) inside the copy-repo-anchor handlers to suppress the NotAllowedError overlay in headless/non-HTTPS contexts; optionally fall back to a hidden textarea + document.execCommand('copy').
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js is 914 lines. Consider splitting Sidebar, Hero, Topology, GateLadder, EvidenceGrid+Drawer, LiveModeCurtain, Roadmap into files under src/components/dashboard/ for maintainability.
Unhandled promise rejection on clipboard.writeText leaks to window error handler and triggers React dev overlay.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 1 already validated backend endpoints and drawer content in depth. This iteration re-validated all frontend UI expectations after the design-only pass. Only outstanding item is the clipboard rejection handling on the two copy-repo-anchor buttons.
